The proof that craftsmanship and talent need another ingredient to achieve excellence: Joy. 12 Year Old Rare Casks is a true expression of Master Blender Joy Spence's passion. A blend of rare hand-selected pot and column still rums crafted with limestone-filtered water, all aged for a minimum of 12 years in the tropical climate of Jamaica. Toasted oak, dried fruit, hazelnut, dark cocoa, molasses, orange peel, vanilla and hints of coffee: it takes hundreds of characters to describe these aromas, but only a strong one to gather them all.
name: APPLETON ESTATE - 12YO RARE CASKS

tastingDescription:
This blend of rare and hand-selected pot and column still rums have all been aged for a minimum of 15 years in the tropical climate of Jamaica. A rich, full-bodied rum.
Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2024.
name: APPLETON ESTATE - 15 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2021. A 250th anniversary deserves at least 8 years of celebration. Crafted by Master Blender Joy Spence to commemorate the special occasion, this blend of pot and column still rums is aged a minimum of 8 years in the tropical climate of Jamaica. Spicy fruit aromas, hints of honey, vanilla, holiday spice and orange peel notes: a delight to your senses.
name: APPLETON ESTATE - 8 YO RESERVE

tastingDescription: Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2022. 96 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "Extraordinarily aromatic, with notes of overripe banana, green papaya, molasses, toasted almond, and fermented mango. The palate offers more decadent notes of milk chocolate and spiced figs, but not without a peppery kick and touch of funk that this distillery is known for. Outstanding."
name: APPLETON ESTATE - SIGNATURE BLEND

tastingDescription: Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2022. 96 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "Extraordinarily aromatic, with notes of overripe banana, green papaya, molasses, toasted almond, and fermented mango. The palate offers more decadent notes of milk chocolate and spiced figs, but not without a peppery kick and touch of funk that this distillery is known for. Outstanding."

tastingDescription: Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2022. 96 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "Extraordinarily aromatic, with notes of overripe banana, green papaya, molasses, toasted almond, and fermented mango. The palate offers more decadent notes of milk chocolate and spiced figs, but not without a peppery kick and touch of funk that this distillery is known for. Outstanding."
name: APPLETON ESTATE - SIGNATURE BLEND

tastingDescription: This amber-colored liqueur owes its rich and nutty flavour to a careful blend of crushed apricot kernels, fresh apricot juice and brandy. Presenting hints of cognac and almond, with a beautiful base of juicy ripe apricots, Bols Apricot Brandy Liqueur tastes amazing in various cocktails to create at home. This full-bodied apricot liqueur has long been a staple in mixology, bringing life to cocktails like the Mai Tai, Zombie and Apricot Brandy Sour. Its almondy notes are somewhat reminiscent of an Amaretto and are supported by subtle hints of orange, but it's the fresh apricot juice that gives the Bols Apricot Brandy liqueur its distinctively rich flavour.
name: APRICOT BRANDY - BOLS

tastingDescription: 92 Points, Whisky Advocate: "This single-estate rye whisky, Scotland's first rye in over a century, lets you lose yourself in deep clove spiciness, dark chocolate, Brazil nut, orange peel, and aromas of pressed cigars. The flavor is astonishingly good, with marmalade, old-fashioned toffee, rye bread, and toasted malt biscuits before a shower of clove spices breaks through, with dark toffee, treacle, chocolate, and pepper leading into a long finish of toffee and spice." (Spring 2019)
name: ARBIKIE - HIGHLAND RYE ARMAGNAC FINISH

tastingDescription: 96 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "Cream soda and smoke, with apple jelly and lemon drizzle. Awe-inspiring combination of luscious sweetness and sour gooseberry, kiwi and apple jelly. Beautifully spiced finish."
name: ARDBEG - 10 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription:
Inspired by the golden age of 1960s Italian cinema, Ardbeg Dolce is the Ardbeg Day 2026 limited edition release, where Sicilian sweet meets Islay peat. Matured in Sicilian marsala wine casks and classic bourbon barrels, fragrant aromas of apricot, orange marmalade, and plump raisins give way to dark chocolate, roasted nuts, and smoky applewood. A taste of la dolce vita, Islay-style—bold, charming, and blazing with a long, lingering finish.
Gold, International Spirits Challenge 2026.
name: ARDBEG - 15 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: From the Ardbeg Distillery to Port Ellen and beyond, follow the rocky coast and you will discover the heavenly vista of Traigh Bhan (pronounced tri-van), the beautiful beach known locally as the Singing Sands. A slightly oily mouthcoating leads into an intense, minty sweetness. Waves of signature Ardbeg notes in creosote, coal tar soap, and bonfire embers follow. Whiffs of smoked pineapple and toasted bread swirl around deep, rich flavours of dark chocolate, peppermint cream, and camphor. A long and unhurried finish carries with it notes of coffee grounds and liquorice.
name: ARDBEG - 19 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription:
The ancient settlement of Trudernish—part of Islay's 'Enchanted Cape'—inspires this beguilingly smoky, creamy dram. Suffused in notes of woodsmoke, the spirit spends time in bourbon, new charred oak, and oloroso sherry casks for a rich vanilla essence. Aged 15 years for a mellow creaminess.
Double Gold, International Spirits Challenge 2026.
1 bottle limit.
name: ARDBEG - DOLCE

tastingDescription: A high gravity mashing experiment, matured in classic Ardbeg Bourbon barrels at 48.3% ABV. This Ardbeg ramps up the levels of fruitiness to astronomical levels, drawing in flavour from the deepest, darkest corners of the mash tun.
name: ARDBEG - SMOKIVERSE

tastingDescription: 94 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "Ginger, cinnamon doughnuts, apple compote, fruitcake, lemon grass and gorse. A smoky sweet, ashy green delight."
name: ARDBEG - UIGEADAIL

tastingDescription: 96 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "A nose filled with sea spray, sea salt, dried cherry, dried fig, freshly hewn oak, and burnt driftwood. Distinctively smoky with further accents of cracked black pepper and pine resin. Incredibly smooth of the palate with strong, flavors of smoked and seasoned meats which hold long into the seemingly endless finish."
name: ARDBEG - WEE BEASTIE 5 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription:
"Oily character that reveals linseed and stewed apple, underscored by hints of coal smoke and char. A delightful blend of chalky mints and roasted apples, sweet peat, and juicy tropical notes..."
95 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2025.
name: ARDBEG - Y2K

tastingDescription:
"Aromatic notes of fresh toasted wood and wood smoke intertwine with vibrant green fruit, evoking a BBQ of caramelized banana and pineapple. The palate reveals delicate fruits alongside smoky toffee fudge..."
96 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2025.
name: ARDNAHOE - INFINITE LOCH

tastingDescription: Ardnamurchan's popular single malt is 50:50 unpeated to peated whisky matured in both ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks, combining their signature coastal characteristics with peat, fruit, and marshmallows.
name: ARDNAMURCHAN - SINGLE MALT

tastingDescription: 96 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "Stately nose with luxurious aromas of soft, chewy caramel, orange marmalade, and oiled teak. The palate is exquisitely smooth, with nuanced touches of dried fruit, nuts, and citrus peel dancing over earthy clove and pipe tobacco before a lengthy, oak-tinged finish ensues."
name: ARMAGNAC DE MONTAL - XO

tastingDescription: 94 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "Linseed oil, lemon zest, liquorice and grapes with a touch of earthy peat in the background. Orchard fruits and a little touch of spice runs through to the finish. Sublime."
name: AUCHENTOSHAN - 12 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: Triple-distilled and matured solely in American bourbon casks. A vibrant bourbon infused vanilla and coconut with layers of zesty citrus fruit, making this Scotch single malt from Auchentoshan stand out from the crowd. A refreshingly smooth whisky taste. Lively, with vanilla cream, coconut and white peach. Crisp, with sugared grapefruit and a lingering hint of spice.
name: AUCHENTOSHAN - AMERICAN OAK

tastingDescription: 92 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "Opulent with a dominant savoury oak character. Notes of forest fruits, kirsch and biscuit add balance to the palate."
name: AUCHENTOSHAN - THREE WOOD

tastingDescription: Whisky Advocate: "Distilled in 1990, this rare expression was matured in refill American oak hogsheads. Quite shy on the nose, even at cask strength. Ultimately, faintly floral notes, with pear drops, vanilla, and linseed. Very smooth on the palate, with soft fruity malt, vanilla, peach, and dark berries. Buttery mango and nutmeg in the finish. Diageo Special Releases 2016" (Winter 2016)
name: AUCHROISK - 25 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: 92 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "This pours a rich black shade and shows soothing aromas of dark chocolate, cola nut, blood orange, and tangy lemon. On tasting, the herbal and bitter notes are expertly balanced by a spun sugar sweetness. Delightful on its own or perhaps better still in one's coffee. "
name: AVERNA - AMARO SICILIANO

tastingDescription: A sublime rum for cocktails, it doesn't dominate other flavours nor disappear when mixed. Perfect for classic rum cocktails like the Mojito. Bacardí Superior Rum is light and aromatically balanced rum. Subtle notes of almonds and lime are complemented by hints of vanilla. The finish is dry, crisp, and clean.
name: BACARDI

tastingDescription: 90 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "A compelling nose of charred oak, cigar box, toasted tobacco, ground dark roasted coffee, cardamom, and clove. This spicy frontal notes and later move into warming vanilla custard, and stewed guava, with subtle accents of pineapple and melon. Exceptionally smooth and gently sweet largely featuring oak on the palate."
name: BACARDI - 8 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: Dark in colour, light-medium in body, rich and robust in taste, Bacardí Black Rum imparts impressions of tropical fruit and molasses, with a smoky finish. Nose: Toasted and nutty. Palate: Tropical and medium-bodied. Finish: Smoky and molasses.
name: BACARDI - BLACK

tastingDescription: A light golden rum with a soft oak flavour. Notes of dry vanilla, ginger root, and toasted almond provide a dry and slightly sweet finish. Nose: Nuts and butter. Palate: Rich and toasted. Finish: Dry and slightly sweet.
name: BACARDI - GOLD

tastingDescription: A light golden rum with a soft oak flavour. Notes of dry vanilla, ginger root, and toasted almond provide a dry and slightly sweet finish. Nose: Nuts and butter. Palate: Rich and toasted. Finish: Dry and slightly sweet.
name: BACARDI - GOLD

tastingDescription: A light golden rum with a soft oak flavour. Notes of dry vanilla, ginger root, and toasted almond provide a dry and slightly sweet finish. Nose: Nuts and butter. Palate: Rich and toasted. Finish: Dry and slightly sweet.
name: BACARDI - GOLD

tastingDescription: Enter for your Chance to Win Groceries for a Year! Bacardi is helping one lucky shopper with a chance to win Groceries for a Year! Look for Bacardi Gold in-stores and enter for your chance to win $20,000 toward groceries! Hurry, contest ends October 24th. Enter at participating BCLIQUOR Stores.
name: BACARDI - GOLD PET

tastingDescription: Bacardí named Limón rum after the Spanish word for lemon. But it gets its fresh flavour from a blend of three citrus fruits; lemon, lime and grapefruit. So what does it taste like? Sunshine!
name: BACARDI - LIMON

tastingDescription: BACARDÍ Spiced, crafted from aged rum, delivers a caramel-like vanilla flavour with subtle notes of almond, dried dark fruits rounded out by cinnamon, nutmeg, and a touch of honey creates a smooth, well-balanced rum with hints of smokiness from charred American oak barrels.
name: BACARDI - SPICED RUM PET

tastingDescription: BACARDÍ Spiced, crafted from aged rum, delivers a caramel-like vanilla flavour with subtle notes of almond, dried dark fruits rounded out by cinnamon, nutmeg, and a touch of honey creates a smooth, well-balanced rum with hints of smokiness from charred American oak barrels.

Made with REAL Belgian chocolate folded into delicious Cream from Ireland, Baileys Chocolate Liqueur delivers a velvety-smooth and delicious treat guaranteed to make any moment extra special. ​​

tastingDescription: Real Colombian coffee and other natural flavours meet yummy Baileys Original Irish Cream for a big bold hit of wonderful flavour. You can enjoy neat, in a coffee cocktail, or splash into coffee and hot drinks.
name: BAILEYS - ESPRESSO CREME

name: BAILEYS - SALTED CARAMEL

tastingDescription: Baja Rosa is a strawberry cream liqueur made with real dairy cream, natural strawberry flavour and 100% agave tequila imported from Mexico.
name: BAJA ROSA

tastingDescription:
"A ripe, fruity style, packed with fresh green apple, juicy pear and pineapple characters. Wonderfully indulgent on the palate, with warm flavours of runny honey and lemon sponge..."
98 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022.
name: BALBLAIR - 12YO

tastingDescription: 96 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "A delightfully soft, floral and fruity nose with nutty tones. Ably supported by an oily and barley sugar character. The delicate palate is fresh, creamy and fruity, with spice that ascends wonderfully."
name: BALLANTINE'S - FINEST

tastingDescription: 96 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "A delightfully soft, floral and fruity nose with nutty tones. Ably supported by an oily and barley sugar character. The delicate palate is fresh, creamy and fruity, with spice that ascends wonderfully."
name: BALLANTINE'S - FINEST

tastingDescription: 96 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "A delightfully soft, floral and fruity nose with nutty tones. Ably supported by an oily and barley sugar character. The delicate palate is fresh, creamy and fruity, with spice that ascends wonderfully."

tastingDescription: 96 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "A delightfully soft, floral and fruity nose with nutty tones. Ably supported by an oily and barley sugar character. The delicate palate is fresh, creamy and fruity, with spice that ascends wonderfully."
name: BALLANTINE'S - FINEST

tastingDescription: 98 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2021: "Pink grapefruit zest and boiled sweets are harmoniously integrated into cooked apples with soft sherry spice and a touch of blackberry cordial. Sweet vanilla with delicate creamy caramel, toffee and chocolate melt into a spicy finish."
name: BALVENIE - 12 YEAR OLD DOUBLEWOOD

sort: BALVENIE - 14 YEAR OLD CARIBBEAN RUM CASK
tastingDescription: 94 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "Treacle tart and apple sauce with pears poached in red wine and gentle cinnamon spice. Soft and creamy with an abundance of apples and an appealingly spicy, long finish."
name: BALVENIE - 14 YEAR OLD CARIBBEAN RUM CASK
nameSanitized: balvenie - 14 year old caribbean rum cask

tastingDescription: 93 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2022: "Bright and vibrant, with balanced peat and smoked gooseberries on a meaty and fruity nose, with touches of mint. Smoke caresses the palate along with citrus peel and orchard fruits."
name: BALVENIE - WEEK OF PEAT 14YO

tastingDescription: Clear and bright with subtle silver tones. Intense aromas of cooked agave layered with fresh mint, citrus zest and hints of grapefruit. Smooth and lightly sweet on the palate, with vibrant fruit notes and a fresh, clean finish that highlights pure agave character.
name: BANDIDO DE AMORES - PLATA TEQUILA

tastingDescription: Made from 100% Blue Weber Agave. Golden in colour with warm sunset hues, it offers aromas of vanilla and caramel from barrel ageing. Fresh and silky on the palate, cooked agave honey layers with oak and caramel, finishing smooth, balanced, and elegant.
name: BANDIDO DE AMORES - REPOSADO TEQUILA

tastingDescription: 95 Points, International Wine & Spirit Competition 2021: "Caramel notes on the nose with a creamy body and strong vanilla sweetness. Notes of strawberry mousse, vanilla again and candy floss on the complex palate. White pepper and chocolate on the long finish." Banff Ice is made from the finest grains and is triple-distilled using Canadian glacier born Rocky Mountain water. Its unique cold filtering process removes unwanted impurities and creates an extra smooth and pure taste.
name: BANFF ICE

tastingDescription: Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition: "Bareksten Botanical Gin is an extraordinary gin that has been slowly and carefully developed over several years. 19 of the 26 herbs and spices are local and harvested close to the distillery in Norway. Smooth, rich in flavour and exceptional for cocktails or neat on its own." (2023)
name: BAREKSTEN - BOTANICAL GIN

tastingDescription:
"Exuding a rich aroma of vanilla, toast, and stewed cereal grain, complemented by toffee and a hint of butter, the whisky offers a butterscotch sweetness that transitions to peppery cinnamon and cooked apple notes. The round, luscious mouthfeel precedes a persistent finish of caramel, vanilla, mild pipe tobacco, and maple syrup flavours supported by a sturdy oak presence."
Category Winner: Canadian Blended, World Whiskies Awards 2024.
name: BARIL CACHE - CANADIAN WHISKY

tastingDescription: From the sip, BEAR-BON is vibrant and full bodied with a kick of lively rye spice and aromatic grain character. Smooth layers of toasted oak and caramel with a hint of fruit. Bold and structured, this whisky is crafted for savoring a grain‑forward taste of Canadian terroir.
name: BEARFACE - BEAR-BON CHARRED BARREL WHISKY

tastingDescription: Bearface Triple Oak offers a rich blend of honey, marzipan, and crème brûlée from American oak; dried fruits and cranberries from French oak; and spice, black cardamom, and orange peel from Hungarian oak. Elemental aging adds a bold, smooth finish.
name: BEARFACE - TRIPLE OAK CANADIAN WHISKY

tastingDescription: Bearface Wilderness Series 3 offers crisp botanical notes with hints of fresh wood and slightly smoked leather. The palate reveals a fresh green, almost botanical entry with intense mineral sweetness. It finishes with light oak and a long, bold, broody note, capturing the essence of rarefied mountain air.
name: BEARFACE - WILDERNESS SERIES 03

tastingDescription: Becherovka's timeless taste has remained proudly unchanged since 1807. Initially you will feel a prominent bitter taste with dominant notes of clove and cinnamon on your palate. After swallowing the real strength of herbs appears combined with bitter orange and sweet after taste.
name: BECHEROVKA

tastingDescription: A particularly fresh, clean and crisp gin with a key note of juniper, a subtle citrus and fruit edge, balanced by the spice of coriander and the earthiness of angelica.  Beefeater is a versatile, sociable spirit: its multi-dimensional character means it blends well with other flavours.
name: BEEFEATER - LONDON DRY

tastingDescription: Bell's Original comprises up to 40 different malt and grain whiskies. The "heart malt" of Bell's is Blair Athol, while the Speyside malt of Dufftown and the Lowlander Glenkinchie help to shape the blend's character, along with a quantity of Caol Ila from Islay, which adds a touch of island influence. Bell's Original may be summed up as offering soft grains and spices on the floral and fruity nose, with a sweet, nutty, malty and spicy palate, which yields just a hint of peatiness.
name: BELL'S - ORIGINAL

tastingDescription: Belvedere Dirty Brew fuses the sophistication of organic rye vodka with the bold taste of roasted organic robusta coffee flavours. Rich espresso and toffee notes are layered with dark chocolate and a velvety finish. Intensely smooth, it can be enjoyed neat, over ice, or in an elevated affogato dessert serve.
name: BELVEDERE - DIRTY BREW

tastingDescription: Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2022. Made from Polish rye, purified water and a distillation process by fire, Belvedere contains zero additives, is certified kosher, and is produced in accordance with the legal regulations of Polish vodka that dictate nothing can be added.
name: BELVEDERE - ORGANIC VODKA

tastingDescription: B&B By Bénédictine is one of the oldest premixed cocktails. In the 1930s, during Prohibition in the United States, a barman at Club 21 in Manhattan came up with the idea of mixing brandy with Bénédictine. In 1937, Le Palais Bénédictine decided to produce this by blending 60% Bénédictine with 40% fine French brandy, allowing the flavours to rest and harmonise in small, vintage French oak barrels that have previously been used to age only the finest cognacs. Nose: Light herbal and spicy fragrance with pleasant aromas of dried fruits. Taste: Drier palate with soft woody notes with a mild finish of honey.
name: BENEDICTINE - B AND B

tastingDescription:
This exquisite single malt has been crafted from peated spirit and four-cask-matured for at least 30 years in sherry casks, bourbon barrels, virgin oak casks, and port casks from the Douro Valley.
Double Gold, San Francisco World Spirits Competition 2025.
name: BENRIACH - 30 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: Drawing upon decades of experience, Benriach's Master Blender Rachel Barrie has skilfully combined some of their rarest malt to create Benriach The Forty. Fine bourbon casks made from American oak have gradually developed exquisite notes of honeyed pomelo and ripe stone fruits. This intricate character is interwoven with dark notes of chocolate, rich plum, and smooth walnut from port casks sourced from the Douro Valley in Portugal. The result is the ultimate expression of Benriach's signature, luscious, fruit-laden style.
name: BENRIACH - 40 YEAR OLD

tastingDescription: 96 Points, Ultimate Spirits Challenge 2022: "Soft melodies of warm cereal, almond biscotti, maple honey, backed bramble fruit sing from the glass. The palate is equally as soothing with warming notes of chopped hazelnut, macadamia nut, mocha, and red cherry."
name: BENRIACH - THE TWELVE

tastingDescription: This single barrel was exclusively selected for BCLIQUOR. The first-ever single cask of Benromach chosen for BCLIQUOR is a 12-year-old first-fill ex-bourbon barrel distilled in 2013. Benromach's explosive, complex character is highlighted here with a twist, emphasizing sweet citrus and tropical fruit notes, with subtle smoke in the background and a long finish reminiscent of creamy milk chocolate and spice.
name: BENROMACH  - SINGLE CASK 491

tastingDescription: The first edition of the Benromach Small Batch series. Carefully matured in hand-selected first-fill bourbon and sherry casks, this 22-year-old single malt delivers rich raspberry, strawberry and cranberry aromas. Dried ginger and dark chocolate leads to intense orange marmalade. Green apple notes before sweet smoke. Smooth and sweet with stewed apple, rich Seville orange flavours, and charred oak gives way to strawberry liquorice.
name: BENROMACH  - SMALL BATCH EDITION #1 22YO

tastingDescription: Benromach's Contrast range typically showcases creative and unique expressions, but this edition is a take on a Speyside classic: the 12-year-old unpeated and heavily sherried single malt. Benromach's rich, heavy spirit is perfectly suited to these first-fill oloroso sherry casks whether peated or unpeated; this unpeated version is packed with aromas of morello cherry, fruitcake, and roasted hazelnuts, leading to lingering succulent juicy berry, citrus peel, raisins, and butterscotch on the finish.
name: BENROMACH  - UNPEATED 12YO

tastingDescription: Unpeated offers a twist on the signature Benromach style as it uses 100% unpeated barley. This limited-edition release has matured in both bourbon and sherry casks.
name: BENROMACH  - UNPEATED 2014

tastingDescription: Benromach Contrasts showcases this rich single malt matured in cask types unusual for the distillery. In this case, the finest virgin American oak casks for ten years. It is quite sweet, with vanilla, hints of coconut, citrus zest, and green apple, followed by hints of ginger biscuits and white pepper. The finish is quite long and spicy, with fresh lemon notes and butterscotch.

With the installation of new distilling technology and renamed Caperdonich the distillery moved forward.
